messages:
Marin V.: Heads-up  need final webinar concept by EOD. My suggestion: pair a pragmatic engineering deep-dive (cost & latency tuning) with a customer-led case that shows production impact. Reserve a 51 lightning ops segment for failover playbooks. Thoughts?
Diego H.: Love that. Engineering + customer makes it concrete. Ops lightning is a nice short CTA for platform teams.
Priya S.: Agree. We should also be strict about prerecorded demo assets (bench + customer walkthrough) so tech flakiness doesn't derail us.
Marin V.: Good call. Diego, can you run the bench script and capture a 60s highlight? Need quant numbers + 2 lines of narration.
Diego H.: Yep. Will record raw + edited and drop both. I'll caption and include a one-line stat we can use in the product launch post.
Priya S.: Audience segmentation: primary = infra / platform / search engineers; secondary = PMs and solution architects. We'll run two ad creatives.
Marin V.: CTA matrix: 1) Start free trial, 2) Book private demo, 3) Request Dedicated info. We'll wire these into the landing form. Also tag leads with `webinar_infer_may` for tracking.
Priya S.: I'll build the form and the two headline variants for ads: (A) "Cut inference cost without trading latency" (B) "How embedding search scaled to 10M queries/day". Will also make 3 description variants.
Carmen Ops Bot: Reminder: upload prerecorded fallback to /greenroom/webinars/may-infer by Thu 17:00 PT. Ops checklist: test stream ingest, captions, and fallback clip playback.
Marin V.: Run-of-show draft (tight 40m):
```
00:00 - 03m Intro + context (Marin)
03:00 - 12m Engineering deep-dive: batching, quantization, routing (Diego)
12:00 - 26m Customer case + short demo (Priya hosting customer)
26:00 - 31m Ops lightning: live failover + canary rules (Ops lead)
31:00 - 40m Live Q&A + CTAs (All)
```
Diego H.: Rehearsal windows: Wed 9:30 PT dry run (speakers), Thu 10:00 PT tech run (ops + presenters), Fri 11:00 PT dress. Everyone try to join at least one.
Priya S.: Lead routing note: form should include a checkbox "Interested in Dedicated" so AEs can filter. Also add a UTM param set for ad sets.
Marin V.: Targets: 900 registrants, 250 live, 50 MQLs within 2 weeks. Asset list: bench clip, customer short clip, speaker slides, 2 blog drafts (product + customer), 3 ad creatives.
Diego H.: Action items: I'll record bench clip (due Thu 3pm). Priya to build form + ads (due Tue EOD). Marin to finalize run-of-show and schedule rehearsals (due Mon). Carmen Ops Bot will run an automated caption job after upload.
greenroom-bot: Auto-note: if stream error rate >2% for >3 minutes, switch to prerecorded clip and enable chat-only Q&A. Fallback host: Diego H.
Marin V.: Great  I'll circulate calendar invites and a short rehearsal expectations doc. Thanks team.
